summary: Air Water Ventures Limited, a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing its election to rely on the home country practice exemption under Nasdaq Rule 5615(a)(3)(A), opting out of shareholder-approval requirements in Rules 5635(a), (b) and (d) for acquisitions, change-of-control issuances and 20%-plus below-market issuances. Cayman counsel Conyers Dill & Pearman provided the required Home Country Exemption Letter, filed as Exhibit 99.1, certifying Cayman law does not prohibit the practice. No transaction, price or stake is stated. Watch for future dilutive issuances lacking shareholder votes.
